summary: Tested new WEIGHT TRACKING feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 8 new pytest cases in test_weights.py covering create/list/delete weight entries, 400/404 error handling, cascade-delete on dragon removal, and admin export including weight_entries - all passing. Frontend: verified 3rd scale icon on Agamer dragon card, /dragon-weight modal screen opens with correct header/close button, empty states render correctly (latest card, chart, history), registering a weight entry works with success toast and correct UI update, chart (react-native-gifted-charts LineChart) renders correctly with 2+ recent data points and correctly excludes entries older than 12 months while still showing them in history, delete-entry confirm dialog + deletion works and chart reverts to empty state appropriately, weight validation (empty input) shows error toast and blocks submission, close button navigates back to Agamer tab without regression. Fixed 1 stale pre-existing backend test that asserted the old MAX_DRAGONS=5 cap (intentionally removed in a prior session) - updated to assert unlimited dragon creation instead. Full backend suite: 33/33 passing.

integration_issues.flow: Weight entry date picker (weight-form-date-picker) on web preview
integration_issues.issue: @react-native-community/datetimepicker does not support the web platform. Console explicitly logs 'DateTimePicker is not supported on: web'. Tapping the date field on the Expo web preview produces no visible picker UI at all - users testing/using the app via web browser cannot select any date other than 'today' for a weight entry. This will work fine in the native iOS/Android app, but is a functional gap for the web preview target. This also blocked me from testing the 2-months-ago / 13-months-ago date scenarios purely through UI interaction (I worked around it by seeding data directly via the backend API and confirmed the frontend correctly renders/filters it).

action_items: Consider adding a web-compatible fallback for the weight entry date picker (e.g. a conditional Platform.OS === 'web' branch rendering an HTML <input type='date'> or a custom modal calendar) since @react-native-community/datetimepicker has no web implementation. Not a crash, but a real usability gap if this app's web preview is used by end users, not just as a dev tool.
No backend fixes needed - weights API, cascade delete, and admin export all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/weights.py: WeightEntryCreate has no server-side validation preventing weight_grams<=0 (confirmed via test_zero_weight_allowed_by_backend - backend accepts 0g). Frontend correctly guards this client-side, but relying solely on frontend validation means direct API calls (or a future second client) could insert invalid zero/negative weight entries. Minor - recommend adding a Pydantic validator (gt=0) on WeightEntryCreate.weight_grams for defense in depth.
dragons.py delete_dragon correctly cascades to both completions and weight_entries - good practice, verified via test_dragon_delete_cascades_weight_entries.
admin.py export/import correctly round-trips weight_entries alongside other collections.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (fixed 1 stale test assertion for removed MAX_DRAGONS cap)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Weight tracking feature fully implemented and working as specified (backend + frontend). The only notable finding is that native DateTimePicker has zero web support - this is a library limitation, not unique to this feature's implementation, and does not crash the app (tapping the field just does nothing on web). Chart rendering via react-native-gifted-charts confirmed working (LineChart renders with animated line + area fill + axis labels), no crashes observed - this was flagged as highest-risk new element and it works correctly. All other previously-tested features (dragon CRUD, unlimited dragons, schedule bulk-copy/delete, admin appearance) were spot-checked implicitly via regression test suite run (test_backend.py, test_new_features.py, test_admin_appearance.py) with no new breakage.
rca_of_issue: DateTimePicker web issue RCA: @react-native-community/datetimepicker package only ships native iOS/Android implementations; there is no bundled web shim, and the project does not have a custom Platform.OS==='web' fallback in dragon-weight.tsx (or elsewhere the picker is used). This is expected library behavior, confirmed via browser console warning 'DateTimePicker is not supported on: web' - not a regression or logic bug in the app's own code, but worth flagging since this app is being tested/previewed via a web browser.
